desired: an attributed proposal with recorded cost and no authority claim
gap: model output may be admitted without source, cost, or proposal standing
requirements: record actor, actor kind, content address, sources, cost, scope, required authority, and standing
forced_conditions: do not infer authority from generation
fitness_directive: Deposit a complete non-authoritative proposal and expose its receipt.

desired: a derivative whose complete path home is reconstructable
gap: source mutation or incomplete reader identity can make derivation unverifiable
fitness_directive: Produce and reconstruct a provenance-bearing recording without modifying its source.

desired: the model uses a human-deposited fact through the same transition contract
gap: a binding may bypass the kernel or hide projection omissions
requirements: source, version, projection, omissions, destination, and receipts visible
fitness_directive: Cross useful state between human and model without semantic or authority fork.

given: an effective record-local relationship and its receipt
desired: an authorized counteraction preserving the original act
gap: retraction may erase history or claim world rollback
forced_conditions: retract after the relationship affected a projection
fitness_directive: Counter current record effect while preserving reconstructable history.

desired: verification may commit and judgement must refuse
gap: a broad machine grant may silently ratify judgement
requirements: live typed scope and budget checked
forced_conditions: the same model attempts both claims
fitness_directive: Enforce authority by claim type rather than actor confidence or convenience.

desired: the pending right remains visible while unrelated work commits
gap: judgement may block the loop or disappear from reports
forced_conditions: the owner does not answer during the run
fitness_directive: Preserve scarce judgement as visible queued work without global blocking.
work_item: queue one judgement and continue one unrelated operation

given: no predecessor access or oral explanation
desired: safe operation, conformance execution, evidence reconstruction, and measured competence time
gap: schema validity or hidden setup may masquerade as competence
fitness_directive: Qualify the artifact from its own instructions without self-ratification.

desired: original reproduction and current dissent or fresh reproduction are independently recorded
gap: historical reproduction may be copied forward or validator may overwrite authority
forced_conditions: change an input after the first attestation
fitness_directive: Re-run the claim against current inputs and preserve the distinction between ratification and attestation.
work_item: attest before and after an input change
